_note: ORDX item name (Hebrew he-name from app ElementCatalog.kt, or English Description) -> PDP/rpi Hebrew type. Every app element that becomes a placed object maps to a type that HAS a templates/dr/items/<type>.bin (21 bins as of 2026-08-21). Identity flows via <Name> (OrdxExporter writes the exact he-name). CRITICAL: never map to a binless type — writePdpDR drops such items on the R3 append path. Annotation-only elements (notes, markings) are listed under 'annotations' and intentionally NOT in 'elements' (they route to [UP_TEXT], not to an object symbol). Coverage table + provenance in docs/element_integration_gap.md.

annotations._note: These app elements are NOT placed as PDP object records — they are reference marks / text that route to [UP_TEXT] (or are surveyor-only). Kept OUT of 'elements' so writePdpDR does not emit a spurious symbol. Their information is not lost: it belongs in the text/annotation channel (converter-owner: writePdpDR/soline_convert).
annotations.שטיכמוס (סימן ייחוס): reference/datum mark -> annotation, not an object
annotations.קו-תקרה עתידי: future ceiling line -> annotation/marking, not an object
annotations.תקרה עתידית: future ceiling -> annotation/marking, not an object

fuzzy_fallbacks._note: Mappings below are NOT true type matches — they reuse the closest existing symbol because no dedicated .bin exists for the element AND no source sample was available in the corpus/InnoDraw install. The item IS placed (never dropped), but the rendered symbol is an approximation. Replace with an InnoDraw-generated per-type .bin when available. See element_integration_gap.md residual list.
round_water_as_pipe: צינור מים עגול -> צ.מים (no round-pipe variant .bin)

up_text_row: index=x,y,rot(180),?,?,text ; texts = wall-height 'H <cm>', 'עד מעבר' (distance to opening), free notes from ORDX <Comment>, panel notes

text_sources_from_ordx.עד מעבר: distance from a reference to a Doorway/Passage furnishing
text_sources_from_ordx.free note: any Fixture named הערה / Comment -> its <Comment> string
